newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bonn may sell DG Bank stake for 500-600 mln dmk.
newsitem.headline: Bonn may sell DG Bank stake for 500-600 mln dmk.

text.p: The German government is likely to sell its stake of about six percent in cooperative bank DG Bank this year and could earn about 500 to 600 million marks from the transaction, the bank said on Wednesday.

Bonn will initially transfer the stake to Kreditanstalt fuer Wiederaufbau (KfW), the Reconstruction Loan Corporation, which will eventually sell it on to a cooperative bank, DG Bank chief executive Bernd Thiemann told a news conference.
Thiemann said he could imagine the stake may be sold to a Bavarian group of cooperative banks. Alternatively it may be sold to a foreign European cooperative bank, he added.
The stake sale is linked to a planned transformation of DG Bank into a shareholding company, but there are no plans for a bourse flotation, Thiemann said.
Separately, DG Bank said it had a good start in 1997 with operating profit before risk provisions up 21.4 percent in the first four months, driven by growth in commission and interest income.
